title: Getting Started with Hunter Green Business Checking
summary: This document explains how to get started with Hunter Green Business Checking, including e-statements setup (paperless required), $25.00 monthly maintenance fee and the $5,000 balance waiver threshold, 1.0% APY interest tracking, and a $0.00 overdraft fee. It also covers statement access and the referral program (referrer $175, new member $125; up to 10 bonuses/year; referred business deposits $10,000 within 90 days; 60-day minimum relationship).
